name: ExpandDelimitedCellToRowsNode
label: Expand Delimited Cell to Rows
description: Explodes cells of a target column by a delimiter, producing one row per delimited value. Other columns are replicated across the expanded rows.
author: @aventisia

fields.name: TargetColumn
fields.label: Target Column
fields.description: The column whose delimited values are expanded into separate rows.

fields.name: Delimiter
fields.label: Delimiter
fields.description: The delimiter separating values in the target column. Defaults to a comma.

fields.name: TrimValues
fields.label: Trim Values
fields.description: True to trim whitespace around expanded values. Defaults to true.

fields.name: SkipEmptyValues
fields.label: Skip Empty Values
fields.description: True to drop empty expanded values. Defaults to true.
